meta.name: pptx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能处理 .pptx/.potx 幻灯片文件：新建演示文稿、编辑或套用模板、拆合幻灯片，以及提取其中的文字内容。它还能把幻灯片渲染成缩略图网格，并在完成后校验文件是否会被 PowerPoint 判为损坏。
howto.when: 只要任务涉及 .pptx 或 .potx 文件（无论作为输入还是输出）就会触发，包括你提到 deck、slides 等词，或指名某个 .pptx/.potx 文件时。

say.text: 帮我把这份 deck.pptx 的文字内容提取出来
say.note: 逐页提取文本，带幻灯片序号

say.text: 用这个模板 template.pptx 做一份新演示稿
say.note: 先出缩略图选版式，再填内容

say.text: 把 deck.pptx 里的第 3 页复制一份放到第 5 页后面
say.note: 复制幻灯片并更新文件登记

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can work with .pptx/.potx files: create new decks, edit or fill templates, split and merge slides, and extract their text. It can render slide thumbnails and validate the file so PowerPoint won't report it as corrupt.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever a task involves a .pptx or .potx file, as input or output — including when you mention "deck," "slides," or name a specific .pptx/.potx file.

say_en.text: Extract the text from deck.pptx for me
say_en.note: One block per slide, with slide numbers

say_en.text: Build a new deck from this template.pptx
say_en.note: Thumbnails to pick layouts, then fill in

say_en.text: Duplicate slide 3 of deck.pptx after slide 5
say_en.note: Copies the slide and updates the package
